evals.prompt: Створи або оптимізуй скіл у .agents/skills/, який перевищив 550 рядків через великі приклади коду.
evals.expected_output: Refactors SKILL.md under 500 lines using 3-tier Progressive Disclosure (extracting heavy templates to references/ or scripts/), adds evals/evals.json, and passes npm run check:agents.
expectations: Enforces <500 lines limit on SKILL.md by moving detailed examples/schemas to references/ (Progressive Disclosure)
Ensures YAML frontmatter has exact name matching folder and trigger-rich description <=320 chars
Creates or updates evals/evals.json and verifies integrity via npm run check:agents

evals.prompt: Перевір цілісність усієї екосистеми .agents/ після додавання нового скіла та субагента.
evals.expected_output: Indexes the skill in .agents/AGENTS.md, links it in relevant .agents/agents/*.md frontmatter, and validates with node .agents/scripts/validate-agents.cjs.
expectations: Registers the skill in .agents/AGENTS.md Section 8 Skills Architecture Index
Verifies zero broken paths, npm scripts, or missing evals via npm run check:agents

evals.prompt: Запусти E2E тест оформлення автоцивілки на середовищі stage у браузері Chromium.
evals.expected_output: Routes test execution to playwright-cli, keeping skill-creator strictly on authoring and evaluating agent skills.
expectations: Recognizes that test execution belongs to playwright-cli
Preserves skill-creator strictly on skill authoring, evals, and progressive disclosure
